parameters.prompt: Wide 16:9 view from the audience seats toward a stage. Five characters stand in a row, left to right: a pale-blue teardrop robot floating over a glowing floor ring, a halo above, in a gray knit sweater; a round orange robot with a cream belly, round gold glasses and an amber antenna light; a round lime robot on coiled-spring legs with chunky boots and a small lightning bolt, grinning; a doll-like android in a royal-blue tee with thick black glasses and a gold chain; and a person in a homemade costume: a teal cardboard box over the head with eye slots and a drawn smile, a ping-pong-ball antenna, a red and cream knit scarf, jeans and sneakers. A small table holds a giant milkshake and a toy ray gun. Backs of audience robots' heads at the bottom. Game UI: a dark plum panel with a thin gold border top left, a cream paper card top right, a speech bubble above the orange robot, all with blank lines, no text. Stop-motion claymation still: everything sculpted from matte modeling clay with faint thumbprints, chunky rounded forms. A grand 19th-century opera house: gold proscenium with chubby cherubs, red velvet curtains with gold tassels, footlights, horseshoe boxes with tiny clay audience bots in top hats, a gold chandelier. Saturated chalky gold, crimson and cream. Warm footlight glow, soft key light, pink and cyan rim light, a painted desert backdrop. Clean readable silhouettes.
